blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever uma resenha de documentário sobre o absurdo, avaliando com nuance e concedendo pontos, com entonação adequada.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “The Absurd Hour” (documentary, 82 minutes)
paras: This fictional documentary tries to bring Camus’s *Myth of Sisyphus* to life with **long takes** of a quarry worker **hauling stone** uphill. **For all its** austerity, it is **surprisingly** moving. The **voice-over** is **sparing**, and the **score** **knows when to fall silent**. **Admittedly**, the **pacing** drags in the middle, **and** the **talking heads** add little.

Still, the final image, **a smile** at the summit, **lingers**. **If** the film **errs**, it errs **on the side of** restraint. **One does not have to** share Camus’s conclusion **to feel** its force. **Not for everyone, but** for those willing to sit with the question, **a quiet triumph**.

items.q: The documentary is entirely based on archive footage.

items.q: The reviewer finds the pacing flawless.

items.q: The reviewer concedes the film is not for everyone.

blocks.body: Boas resenhas **equilibram** elogio e crítica: concedem pontos (*Admittedly*) antes de concluir (*Still*). A voz desce suavemente em avaliações finais e sobe um pouco na concessão.

items.s: ___ all its austerity, it is moving. (for)
___ , the pacing drags in the middle. (admittedly)
It errs on the ___ of restraint. (side)
One does not have ___ share Camus’s view to feel its force. (to)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Did you find the pacing slow

items.pt: Você compartilha a conclusão de Camus?

body: **For all its flaws,…** — Apesar de seus defeitos,…
**Admittedly,…** — É verdade que…
**Err on the side of caution.** — Pecar pela cautela.
**Stay with someone.** — Ficar na memória.
**Fall flat.** — Não funcionar.
**Strike the right note.** — Acertar o tom.
**Steal the show.** — Roubar a cena.
**Make or break.** — Ser decisivo.
**Worth the price of admission.** — Vale o ingresso.
**A slow burn.** — Combustão lenta.
**Did you find the pacing slow?** — Você achou o ritmo lento?
**Do you share Camus’s conclusion?** — Você compartilha a conclusão de Camus?
**Admittedly, in the middle. But that final smile lingers.** — Admito, no meio. Mas aquele sorriso final permanece.

Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: For all its austerity, it is surprisingly moving.
A quiet triumph for patient viewers.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence review of a film, book or exhibition, using For all its…, Admittedly and err on the side of.
blocks.model: For all its modest budget, the film is gripping. Admittedly, the plot is thin. Yet the acting carries it. If it errs, it errs on the side of caution. One does not have to like thrillers to enjoy the atmosphere. Recommended for patient viewers.
